title: Abbot Suger consecrates the new choir of Saint-Denis
summary: The rebuilt choir of the abbey church of Saint-Denis, with pointed arches, ribbed vaults and large stained glass windows, was consecrated in the presence of King Louis VII.
reason: Abbot Suger wanted a church filled with light to honor God and the French monarchy, whose kings were buried there.
significance: It is considered the first Gothic building, the start of a style that spread across Europe.
